perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Fiscal Q2 2027 revenue was $771.8M, up 30% year over year; Atlas revenue grew about 29% and Enterprise Advanced/other about 36%, with full-year guidance raised mainly due to Atlas.
MongoDB scheduled a September 29 Investor Day; the event is evidence-to-come and should not be treated as realized guidance or execution.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Broad growth across Atlas and Enterprise Advanced plus raised guidance supports execution, while management describes AI momentum as early; durable AI monetization and consumption behavior remain to be demonstrated.

unknowns: AI workload contribution to Atlas consumption
Investor Day long-term targets until released

lineage.searchStrategy: current issuer-primary acquisition; future Investor Day explicitly not pre-counted
